title: Open Analytics: Open-source, privacy-first web analytics
excerpt: Open Analytics is an open-source, privacy-first alternative to Google Analytics: realtime visitors, funnels and revenue attribution from one lightweight, cookieless script. GDPR-friendly with no consent banner, and self-hostable.
content_html:
Three steps from nothing to numbers, and the first one is a copy-paste.

  • 01

    Add it to your site

    One script tag, or one command in your terminal. No SDK, no tag manager, no build step to change. That's all.

  • 02

    The data starts arriving

    Installation

    Waiting for the first event…

    Open your site and browse around; we pick up the first pageview.

    The first pageview lands within seconds: no cookie banner in the way, and nothing to configure before it counts.

  • 03

    Watch it live

    • Product Hunt412100%

    • X26865%

    • Hacker News19447%

    • Google12230%

    Visitors, pages, sources and revenue on one screen, updating as it happens. Switch the cut without leaving the page.

Analytics that answers back. Ask, watch, follow the money.

  • Realtime

    Watch visitors arrive the moment they do, with nothing to refresh.

  • No cookies

    No cookies and no personal data, so there is no consent to ask for.

  • Live globe

    Every visitor on a turning globe, pinned to the country they are in.

  • Integrations

    Bring your history in, and send the numbers where your team already is.

  • AI chat

    Ask your analytics a question and get the number back, not a report.

  • Revenue attribution

    Follow the money back to the campaign, page and post that earned it.

Nothing here is an add-on, and none of it costs extra.

  • Funnels

    Save the steps that matter and watch where people fall out of them, counted by visitor or by session, whichever the question is about.

  • Web vitals

    LCP, INP, CLS and TTFB measured on real visits and split by device, so a slow phone never hides behind a fast desktop.

  • Custom events

    Send anything you want counted (signups, plays, exports) and read them back broken down by value.

  • Visitor journeys

    Follow one anonymous visitor through every page of their session, in order, with where they came from and what they were on.

  • Campaigns and UTMs

    Referrers, campaigns, sources and mediums, each as its own cut, so tagged traffic never lands in Direct.

  • Public dashboards

    Share a read-only board with a link that needs no account and no seat, and reaches nothing else in your site.

  • Team and roles

    Invite the whole team as owner, admin or viewer, and change anyone's role later. Nobody is charged per seat.

  • Privacy first

    Privacy is the default, not a setting. Nothing personal is collected, and no profile follows anyone between sites or between days.

  • Fast, by construction

    Every query runs on ClickHouse, the column store built for exactly this. A year of events answers before a spinner appears.

You were going to compare us anyway. So we made the table ourselves.

blocks.html_en: Get Started

content_html_zh:
从无到有的三个步骤，第一步是复制粘贴。

  • 01将其添加到您的站点一个脚本标签，或终端中的一个命令。 没有 SDK，没有标签管理器，没有需要更改的构建步骤。 就这样。
  • 02数据开始到达安装等待第一个活动…打开您的网站并浏览；我们获取第一个综合浏览量。第一个综合浏览量在几秒钟之内就到达了：没有 cookie 横幅，并且在计算之前无需进行任何配置。
  • 03观看直播产品狩猎412100%X26865%黑客新闻19447%Google12230%访客、页面、来源和收入在一个屏幕上，实时更新。 无需离开页面即可切换剪辑。

做出回应的分析。 询问、观察、追随金钱。

  • RealtimeWatch 访问者一到达就到达，无需刷新任何内容。
  • 没有cookies没有cookies，也没有个人数据，因此无需征求同意。
  • 实时地球仪 转动的地球仪上的每位访客都被固定在他们所在的国家/地区。
  • 集成将您的历史记录带入，并将号码发送到您的团队已经所在的位置。
  • 人工智能聊天向您的分析提出问题并返回数字，而不是报告。
  • 收入归属跟踪资金返回到赚取资金的活动、页面和帖子。

这里没有任何附加组件，也不需要额外付费。

  • 漏斗保存重要的步骤，并观察人们从哪些步骤中掉出来，按访客或按会话进行计数，无论问题涉及哪一个。
  • Web VitalsLCP、INP、CLS 和 TTFB 根据实际访问量进行测量，并按设备划分，因此速度较慢的手机永远不会隐藏在速度较快的桌面后面。
  • 自定义事件发送您想要计数的任何内容（注册、播放、导出）并按值将其读回。
  • 访客旅程跟踪一位匿名访客，按顺序浏览其会话的每一页，包括他们来自哪里以及他们在浏览什么内容。
  • 营销活动和 UTM 引荐人、营销活动、来源和媒介，每个都有自己的剪辑，因此标记的流量永远不会登陆 Direct。
  • 公共仪表板共享一个只读板，其中包含一个不需要帐户和席位的链接，并且不会到达您网站中的任何其他内容。
  • 团队和角色邀请整个团队作为所有者、管理员或查看者，并稍后更改任何人的角色。 没有人按座位付费。
  • 隐私第一隐私是默认设置，而不是设置。 不会收集任何个人信息，也不会在网站之间或几天之间跟踪任何人的个人资料。
  • 通过构建快速每个查询都在 ClickHouse 上运行，ClickHouse 正是为此构建的列存储。 在旋转器出现之前，一年的事件得到了答案。

无论如何，你都会比较我们。 所以我们自己做了桌子。
